scenes.big: Bad sleep shows in your eyes
scenes.say: Slept badly? Your eyes feel it first. Here are three things poor sleep does to them.

scenes.en: Closed eyelids keep the eye moist. Eye muscles get a long rest.
scenes.say: While you sleep, your closed eyelids keep the eye surface moist, and your eye muscles finally get a long rest.

scenes.en: Fewer hours with eyes closed + late screens = dry, irritated eyes.
scenes.say: Number three: dry, red eyes. Fewer hours with eyes closed, plus late night screens, leave the surface dry and irritated.

scenes.en: Often linked to tiredness, stress and too much coffee.
scenes.say: Number two: eyelid twitching. That annoying flutter is often linked to tiredness, stress, and too much coffee. It usually settles with rest.

scenes.en: Tired focusing muscles: heavy eyes, blurred reading, headaches.
scenes.say: Number one: eye strain. Tired focusing muscles mean heavy eyes, blurred reading, and headaches by evening.

scenes.en: Adults need about 7 or more hours of sleep a night.
scenes.ta: பெரியவர்களுக்கு தினமும் 7 மணி நேரத்துக்கு மேல் தூக்கம் தேவை
scenes.say: Did you know? Health experts say adults need about seven or more hours of sleep every night.

scenes.en: Phone away 1 hour before bed. Dim lights. A cool, clean, damp cloth on tired eyes.
scenes.ta: தூங்கும் 1 மணி நேரம் முன் போனை வையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Tonight, put the phone away an hour before bed, dim the lights, and rest a cool, clean, damp cloth on tired eyes.

scenes.en: Twitching for weeks, a drooping eyelid, or other face twitches.
scenes.ta: வாரக்கணக்கில் துடிப்பு, இமை தொங்கினால் மருத்துவரிடம் செல்லுங்கள்
scenes.say: If twitching lasts for weeks, the eyelid droops, or other parts of the face twitch, see a doctor. And if strain continues, book an eye test.
